market_summary: Late New York session trading is characterized by broad consolidation and volatility compression across all asset classes following earlier morning flushes. Metals (XAUUSD, XAGUSD) and FX majors (EURUSD, GBPUSD) are pinned against multi-touch session low supports on sub-1.0 RVOL, presenting high trap risk for late shorts and no confirmation for counter-trend longs. US100 is contained in a positive dampening GEX regime testing VAL resistance from below, while BTCUSD chops mid-channel inside its session value area. With zero setups meeting the 7-point confluence threshold, capital preservation mandates HOLD across the entire portfolio.
